color.chart.neutral: A secondary color for data visualisation or to communicate 'to-do' statues.
color.chart.brand: Our primary color for data visualisation. Use when only one color is required.
color.chart.danger: For data visualisation communicating negative information, such as 'off track'.
color.chart.danger.bold: A stronger emphasis option of color.chart.danger.
color.chart.warning: For data visualisation communicating caution, such as 'at risk' statuses.
color.chart.warning.bold: A stronger emphasis option of color.chart.warning.
color.chart.success: For data visualisation communicating positive information, such as 'on track'.
color.chart.success.bold: A stronger emphasis option of color.chart.success.
color.chart.discovery.bold: A stronger emphasis option of color.chart.discovery.
color.chart.information: For data visualisation communicating low priority or in-progress statuses.
color.chart.information.bold: A stronger emphasis option of color.chart.information.
